rules: Stage image files only on the authorized Google Cloud VM; never download an image archive to this Mac.
Do not accept a dataset-specific legal agreement, DUA, or access condition on the user's behalf.
Original images only where augmented variants exist; split augmentation families together.
Perform exact/near-duplicate and source-overlap checks before any held-out result is called external.
Use patient-grouped splits whenever patient identifiers exist; where they do not, report only image-level exploratory estimates.
Train disease-specific binary experts only where labels define the same condition and enough independent patient support exists; rare conditions remain exploratory or no-go.
